object.name: evi.ringmod.diode~
object.description: Piece-wise approximation of a 4-diode ring modulator, naive implementation heavily oversampled for clean anti-aliasing, so not very efficient. But it has it's own interesting sound and is very different to <o>evi.ringmod~</o>.
object.discussion: @see: 'A Simple Digital Model of the Diode-based Ring-Modulator', DAFx-11, 2011, by Julian Parker.

inlets.description: First signal to be ring modulated (Carrier).
Second signal to be ring modulated (Modulator).

outlets.description: Audio output of the ring modulator.

arguments.name: upsample
arguments.description: Oversampling factor for the core ring modulator algorithm. Can be 16, 32 or 64. Default 32. Can only be a typed in argument.

attributes.name: knee
attributes.description: Soft knee..Hard knee 0..1. A harder knee increases the asymmetrical saturation in the diodes.

attributes.name: slope
attributes.description: Soft..Hard 0..1. Slope increases the gain staging at the input to the diodes.

attributes.name: voltage
attributes.description: Increasing the voltage not only increases the gain but also smooths the diode shaping leading to more intelligable harmonics.
